snippet.title: Kitchen Wars Steam Trailer
snippet.description: Kitchen Wars: Appetiser is the limited first taste of a fast-paced party game with 2-8 players that plunge players into the chaos of a restaurant, where they must engage in strategic fights and theft while catering to their clients.
